title: RAW UNREVIEWED: ending-preserving contraction with source-linked lexical expansion in prose and labels
summary: A finite source-attested contraction law preserves written lexical carriers and inflectional endings while restoring an omitted interior sequence. One shared spelling key and linked full-word analyses must decode complete prose and isolated nominal labels; no free target whole-word dictionary or guessed suffix translation.

design.hypothesis: Target reusable parts encode surviving source spelling plus a bounded contraction/expansion mark. Each candidate whole is tied to an attested abbreviated/full-spelling pair and one complete compatible lemma/morphological analysis. Labels may realize citation forms; prose may realize inflected forms of the same lemma through the identical writing law. Register alone cannot choose a new key or expansion.

design.finite_contract: Before target fitting, choose a small source-derived set of at most6 linked contraction families. Retained spelling, mark identity, restoration position and allowed full-word alternatives are exact source fields. A family may vary only through declared source-attested letter/morphological contexts. Preserve marks and whole-form residuals; no universal vowel deletion, null restoration, arbitrary lemma escape or per-target expansion. Optional versus mandatory abbreviation must be learned from the source pair, not imported from synthetic controls.

This candidate instead predicts exact paired full words and their grammatical endings. Unlike609/613–616, its expansion inventory is externally bounded by observed source pairs, not34 invented role slots or a repaired merge budget. new_measurement_needed: Source-only annotation of complete Ste1 procedures and a bounded prechosen Nuremberg record: explicit abbr/ex/full-word alignment, retained ending, stem identity and full morphological alternatives. Obtain at least two lexical stems with the same contraction family across differing endings and record fully written counterparts; absence stops this particular prior.
Independently verify the complete word/mark parsing used by the spelling channel. No EVA or98BPE phonetic identification follows from segmentation.

Only after source rule freeze, root may nominate currently owned whole prose and isolated label scopes. Two nonseed complete consumers must reuse the same observed spelling key and linked lemma/ending analysis; no convenient English value or new source word may be introduced.
design.reading_decision_consequence: Under a fixed key, the label lemma and prose inflection must agree in lexical identity while the inflection changes an actual grammatical role or number in the full proposition. A incompatible nominative/genitive, singular/plural or governing construction rejects that whole reading. Multiple compatible lexical keys remain ambiguous; grammatical linkage does not choose a plant name.
design.falsifier: Reject the declared writing law if the externally frozen source contraction families fail complete source-word reconstruction, or if target label/prose reconstruction requires contradictory key outputs, unlicensed endings or occurrence-specific restoration. Failure rejects this bounded channel, not all abbreviation/languages.
